title: China Launches Origin Wukong-180: Fourth-Generation 180-Qubit Quantum Computer
detail: China's Origin Quantum launches Origin Wukong-180, its fourth-generation superconducting quantum computer, built on a single-chip architecture with 180 computational qubits and 251 coupling qubits — all domestically developed. The system goes live and begins accepting computing tasks from global users, advancing China's drive for quantum self-sufficiency.

media.caption: China's Origin Wukong-180: fourth-generation 180-qubit quantum computer goes live
